known.via: English Wikipedia "Paso Robles Estrella District AVA"

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: One of eleven districts inside the Paso Robles AVA, in San Luis Obispo County, California. It sits in the north-central part, northeast of the city of Paso Robles on both sides of the Estrella River watershed, with valleys and terraces.
